englishTranslation: Thick noodle soup with fish cakes
atAGlance: Bánh canh chả cá is thick noodle soup with springy fish cakes and a light seafood broth. It is gentler than crab bánh canh but still has the chewy noodle texture.
whatItIs: Bánh canh chả cá pairs thick chewy noodles with fish cakes and a light seafood broth. It is springy, gentle, and easier than many shellfish-heavy soups.
howToEnjoy: Taste a fish cake with broth before adding lime or chili. The fish cake texture should be bouncy, not flaky.
howLocalsOrder: Bánh canh chả cá is the fish-cake version, so order it when you want springy fish cakes more than crab. Ask for extra chả cá or less pepper before the bowl is finished.
worthKnowing: Chả cá can mean fish cake in many everyday menu contexts, not only the famous Hanoi turmeric fish dish.
goodToKnow: Chả cá means fish cake here. The fish is usually formed into slices or patties, not a whole fillet.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bánh canh chả cá.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of thick noodle soup with fish cakes.
